about: Every kernel the source defines (tools/kernels.py) and how it meets each obligation: a pointer to the artifact that meets it (a test file, `file::test`, a budget, a sanitizer row of tools/sanitize_oracle.py), {"exempt": reason}, or {"owed": reason}. Checked by tools/lint/coverage.py, gated as a ratchet: an owed entry is backlog, and a kernel absent from this file fails the commit. Docs: docs/internals/tools/coverage.md

obligations.oracle: a test grading the kernel against a reference per slot (an fp64 oracle, or a bit-exact model of a discrete function)
obligations.sanitizer: a row of tools/sanitize_oracle.py's family table whose cell launches the kernel
obligations.phases: a phase ledger the kernel books and a test or tool that reads it (KERNEL_STANDARDS §22)

oracle.owed: its reader (tests/unit/test_carry_surface.py) only asserts an int; read it against the footprint the source declares, as decode's and intra's are

budget.exempt: a footprint stamp, not a workload

phases.exempt: a footprint stamp, not a workload
